name: SOLID: a bank of modes struck by a mallet, a noise burst or sustained noise, from string to glass
description: model27's own machine (notes/71): eight modes, each a rotating phasor in fixed point on the EMAC, struck by a mallet whose contact follows the pitch, a noise burst or sustained noise. Body glides through string, membrane, marimba, bar, bell and glass; Bright bends the body's own levels and decays; Pickup is the point the body is heard at; DECAY is the body's T60, 20 ms to 8 s. A strike halves the ringing body; one on another note or material damps it by 12 dB first. The amp envelope stays open and SOLID does not call the VCA: the body has its own decay and GATE; PUNCH as on TONE. No shortcut. A card in the flasher (notes/71 §12).
